title: Index Page - Document Structure and Component Families
rules: Document MTQ-000 serves as the front page/cover
Document MTQ-001 contains the general index
TAB series documents contain specific technical sheets organized by topic
Family series documents (66300-A through 66600) contain component-specific standards
training_guidance: This is the primary index page for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook MTQ-000 dated 26.10.2010
The handbook is organized into TAB sheets covering general standards (threading, sealing, bearings, etc.) and Family sheets covering specific component types
When modeling gears, reference Family 66300-66450 for piston shafts, spline shafts, and gear components
When modeling shafts, reference Family 66300-66311 for various shaft types including hollow shafts and shafts with splines
TAB sheets 001-018 contain cross-cutting standards applicable across component families
The document uses a hierarchical structure: MTQ documents for top-level organization, TAB for technical sheets, and Family codes for component-specific guidance
summary: This is the index page (1/3) of Bonfiglioli's Technical Quality Handbook MTQ-000. It presents the document structure including TAB reference sheets covering general technical standards (threading, sealing, bearings, splines, etc.) and Family index entries for specific component types such as piston shafts (66300-A), spline shafts (66301-B), hollow shafts (66301, 66311), planetary pins (66345-A), ring gears (66410-A), planetary gears (66420), sun gears (66430), and related power transmission components. This page serves as a navigation aid to locate detailed technical specifications organized by component family.
